sloka: ते दूता रामवाक्येन चोदिता लघुविक्रमाः ।प्रजग्मुर्मधुरां शीघ्रं चक्रुर्वासं न चाध्वनि ।। ७.१०८.१ ॥
transliteration: te dūtā rāmavākyena coditā laghuvikramāḥ ।prajagmurmadhurāṁ śīghraṁ cakrurvāsaṁ na cādhvani ।। 7.108.1 ॥

translations.english: Those messengers, urged by Rama's command and swift in their journey, quickly set forth for Mathura and did not make any halts on the way.
